methodology: Repeated fresh Windows GUI processes; sequential without builds/tests. Active/exposed validation points; synthetic Qt input and QWidget paint completion, not physical display presentation. Normal background drafts. Scope intervals are inclusive and must not be summed across nesting. Exclusive phase stages are separate. First action for a target is the first action in the measured phase; startup already used VLOOK. Each first_paint_scope_ms matches the recorded paint completion within 3 ms, or is null. All samples, theme timelines and working-set measurements retained; nearest-rank quantiles checked from raw samples and clock differences. Working sets are not heap sizes or guaranteed peaks. Small samples do not establish a population tail.

before.method: Native exposed MainWindow, standard app bindings, independent producer posts synthetic Qt keyboard/wheel/tab/action events at fixed cadence. Paint means completed QWidget paint dispatch, not DWM/display presentation. Nearest-rank quantiles; raw samples included. 8ms GUI heartbeat and 20ms working-set sampler. Isolated settings/files; autosave and update checks disabled; normal recovery-draft timers retained.
